name: Casper
intro: From a cold street corner to a cozy home in Milan.
before_body: Casper was alone on the street, his white fur matted and dirty and his eyes sore and teary. He was tired, but he still let us pick him up.
care_body: His matted fur had to be shaved off, his eyes were cleaned and treated, and little by little he got his strength back.
after_body: Today Casper lives in Milan, Italy, with soft blankets, a chair of his own and a family who loves him.
